post.summary: Make an account and sign in. 409 when the email already has one.
Sign in. 401 for a wrong email or password (the same message for both).

Sign out of every device: all tokens made so far stop working (this one too), and the account's
open live connections are closed. 204. Signing in again makes a new token.

get.summary: The signed-in user. 401 without a valid token, or when the account no longer exists.
The events of a project, earliest first.

patch.summary: Change any of name, color and dates.

post.summary: A new project; you are its first owner. No one has it open yet, so no one is told.

get.summary: The projects you are a member of, newest first.
The project's members and their roles, in the order they joined.

patch.summary: Change a member's role. 409 for the project's last owner.

delete.summary:
Remove a member from the project: an owner may remove anyone, and anyone may leave (remove
themselves). 409 for the project's last owner.

get.summary: The project's pending invitations, oldest first.

post.summary:
Invite someone by email: added as a member at once when they have an account (`added`),
otherwise kept as an invitation until they sign up with it (`invited`). 409 when they are
already a member, or already invited.

A new secret link for a pending invitation, for another INVITE_DAYS days (owners). The old link
stops working. Only the new link's secret is answered, this once.

What a link is for (the project's name, who invited, the role): 404 when unknown or expired.
A POST with the secret in the body, so it stays out of URLs (logs, history).
Join with a link, signed in: a member with its role; the link is used up.

get.summary: Flat list for a project; the client builds the tree from parentId.

patch.summary: Change any of name, description, dates, progress, priority and color.

delete.summary: Sub-tasks of a deleted group are kept and become top-level.

patch.summary: Move a task under a group, or send { "parentId": null } to make it top-level.

Put a task at a place in the list: under a group (or at the top level, with null) and at an
index among the tasks there. The tasks of that level are numbered again to keep that order.

get.summary: Every link between the tasks of a project.

post.summary: Make `toTaskId` come after `fromTaskId`. Rejects self links, duplicates and cycles; moves the successor later if it is too early.

patch.summary: Change the type and/or the lag of a link.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The id of the last revision of the previous page: the next page goes on after it.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many: 50 when left out, at most 100.

get.summary:
The project's history, newest first, 50 at a time (up to 100 with `limit`). For the next page,
pass the id of the last one as `before`.

post.summary:
Put a task, an event or the project back the way it was right after this revision (a deleted
one comes back, with its links where the other task is still there). It is recorded as a new
change ("Restored to version N"). 400 when it can't be put back as things are now.

get.summary: The project's versions, newest first (without their contents).

post.summary: "Save a version now": the project as it is.

get.summary: One version with its contents (to look at it).

patch.summary: Star a version (or take the star off).

post.summary:
A new project of yours made from this version (named "<name> (v3)"); this one is not touched.
Any member may: they can see the version already, and the copy is theirs.

Put the whole project back as it was in this version (tasks, events, links; the name and
description too for an owner). The state it replaces is kept as a version first; newer
versions go, except starred and manually saved ones.

get.summary: What Undo and Redo would do now (null: nothing), for the buttons.

post.summary:
Undo your last change here (from any tab or device). 409 when there is none, or when someone
changed what it changed since (nothing is overwritten).
Redo what your last undo reverted. 409 when there is none, or it no longer fits.
